reason: My architect already does 3D for us, and I bill cost-plus, so a $1,500 line item the homeowner has to agree to is a hard sell when they're already getting renderings. I don't need another vendor in the loop.
objection: My architect already does 3D for us. Why would I pay a second company $1,500 a home and then have to convince the buyer to cover it?
would_change_my_mind: If it worked from my existing library plans for spec homes where there's no architect doing 3D, at well under $500 a plan, so I could eat it as a sales cost without a homeowner approving a line item.
